sentences.zh: 像其他包豪斯教员的妻子一样，露西亚做了人们对她期望的事，即从事

sentences.en: training in photography.
sentences.zh: 摄影训练。

sentences.zh: 她掌握暗房技术，并且拥有当时

sentences.en: of the period.
sentences.zh: 非常出色的专业技能。

sentences.en: So Lucia became a kind of in-house documentarian for the Bauhaus.
sentences.zh: 于是，露西亚成为了包豪斯的内部记录者。

sentences.en: She made portraits
sentences.zh: 她为那里的人们、

sentences.zh: 他们制作的作品以及学校本身的建筑拍摄肖像。

sentences.en: Walter Gropius designed the school's campus in Dessau, and those buildings became a major theme
sentences.zh: 沃尔特·格罗皮乌斯设计了学校在德绍的校区，这些建筑成为了

sentences.en: of Lucia's work.

sentences.en: She photographed the workshops, the dormitories, the master's houses.
sentences.zh: 她拍摄了工作室、宿舍和大师住宅。

sentences.zh: 她着手

sentences.en: showing the spaces where these new methods and philosophies of design were being made.
sentences.zh: 展示这些新的设计方法和哲学得以实现的场所。

sentences.en: You can see the way in which Lucia's photographs of Walter Gropius's architecture express the same
sentences.zh: 你可以看出，露西亚拍摄的沃尔特·格罗皮乌斯的建筑，表达了

sentences.en: ideas that he wanted to express in the architecture itself.
sentences.zh: 他本人想在建筑中表达的相同理念。

sentences.en: And this is not by chance.
sentences.zh: 这绝非偶然。

sentences.en: Lucia's photography, like Gropius's architecture, is all about clarity and simplicity of form.
sentences.zh: 露西亚的摄影，正如格罗皮乌斯的建筑，追求的是形式的清晰与简洁。

sentences.en: It is utilitarian, documenting the world as it is.
sentences.zh: 它是功利主义的，如实记录着这个世界。

sentences.en: And it's also beautiful, reveling in clean lines
sentences.zh: 它同时也是美丽的，沉醉于干净的线条

sentences.en: and stark contrasts.
sentences.zh: 和强烈的对比之中。

sentences.en: And it's minimal, showing only what's needed and nothing more.
sentences.zh: 它也是极简的，只展示必要的部分，不多不少。

sentences.en: From the darkroom in her and Laszlo's home on the Bauhaus campus, Lucia amassed a collection of five
sentences.zh: 在包豪斯校区她和拉兹洛的家中，露西亚在暗房里积累了五

sentences.en: or six hundred photographs.

sentences.zh: 当时她不可能知道这些影像会对

sentences.en: on the built world, or on her own life.
sentences.zh: 建筑界，或者她自己的人生，产生怎样的影响。

sentences.en: The Bauhaus aspired to lift society up out of the wreckage

sentences.en: of World War I, and into a new world of rationalism, beauty, good art, and good design,
sentences.zh: 残骸中拯救出来，带入一个理性、美丽、艺术与设计并存的新世界，

sentences.en: to bring its brand of utopianism into the world at large.
sentences.zh: 将它的乌托邦理念带给整个世界。

sentences.en: But for all their efforts, the world did not become more utopian.
sentences.zh: 但尽管他们付出了所有努力，世界并没有变得更加乌托邦。

sentences.en: The National Socialist government put the Bauhaus under increasing pressure.
sentences.zh: 纳粹政府对包豪斯施加了越来越大的压力。

sentences.en: In 1933, it was closed down by the Nazis.
sentences.zh: 1933年，学校被纳粹关闭。

sentences.en: Many members of the Bauhaus were forced to flee
sentences.zh: 许多包豪斯成员被迫立即逃离，

sentences.en: immediately because they were Jewish, or because they were involved in very left,
sentences.zh: 因为他们是犹太人，或者因为他们参与了非常左翼、

sentences.en: radical politics, and they had to go.
sentences.zh: 激进的政治活动，他们必须离开。

sentences.en: Amidst all the turmoil of the Nazis' rise to power, Laszlo and Lucia had separated.
sentences.zh: 在纳粹掌权带来的动荡中，拉兹洛和露西亚分开了。

sentences.en: Lucia started dating a Communist Party member of parliament.
sentences.zh: 露西亚开始与一位共产党议员约会。

sentences.en: One day in 1933, he was arrested
sentences.zh: 1933年的一天，他在露西亚外出时

sentences.en: in Lucia's apartment while she was out.
sentences.zh: 在她的公寓里被捕了。

sentences.en: So she was not able to return to her apartment because she had to fear that she was arrested
sentences.zh: 所以她无法回到自己的公寓，因为她担心自己也会

sentences.en: immediately too.
sentences.zh: 立即被捕。

sentences.zh: 有人告诉她，不要回你的公寓。

sentences.en: She had to emigrate immediately.
sentences.zh: 她必须立即移民。

sentences.zh: 于是她逃往了她在捷克的家人那里。

sentences.zh: 她先去了布拉格，

sentences.en: first, and then she went to Paris via Austria, via Switzerland.
sentences.zh: 然后经由奥地利、瑞士去了巴黎。

sentences.zh: 国内，任其命运未卜。

sentences.zh: 露西亚在伦敦度过了战争时期。

sentences.en: She had arrived in the city with
sentences.zh: 她抵达这座城市时几乎

sentences.zh: 一无所有，后来当她的公寓被德国

sentences.en: warplanes.
sentences.zh: 战机轰炸时，她再次失去了一切。

sentences.zh: 与此同时，

sentences.en: same time, she was quite a successful portrait photographer for the High Society in London.

sentences.zh: 在很大程度上，她将包豪斯抛在了脑后。

sentences.zh: 那一定是给她的

sentences.en: Images of the dormitories,
sentences.zh: 宿舍的影像，

sentences.zh: 大师住宅，工作室。

sentences.en: Photos that use interesting angles to transform stark rectilinear structures into striking asymmetric

sentences.en: compositions.
sentences.zh: 构图。

sentences.zh: 第二次世界大战后，人们对包豪斯的兴趣激增。

sentences.zh: 他们关于理性主义和现代主义的所有理念，在战后的建筑师和

sentences.zh: 露西亚开始认为，或许，她那套5x7英寸的玻璃底片集

sentences.zh: 露西亚的第一步是写信给她的前夫拉兹洛，他当时已经带着第二任妻子萨贝尔

sentences.zh: 在露西亚完全不知情的情况下，格罗皮乌斯实际上把她的底片带到了
